mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 2.5% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% MoM signals a weakening demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of broader economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST drops by more than 10% MoM and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in 3 months signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises by more than 0.5% in 3 months and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% YoY signals a strong supply side, boosting economic growth and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO YoY growth exceeds 2% and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy, which is expected to boost equity markets, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow by more than 5% YoY and industrial production (INDPRO) grows by more than 2% YoY, it signals strong demand and supply, respectively, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS YoY growth > 5% and INDPRO YoY growth > 2%
failure_condition: If RSAFS and INDPRO meet the growth conditions and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in a month signals a weakening labor market, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS drops by more than 100,000 MoM and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) grows by less than 1% QoQ and housing starts (HOUST) drop by more than 5% MoM, it signals a weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 QoQ growth < 1% and HOUST drops > 5% MoM
failure_condition: If GDPC1 and HOUST meet the decline conditions and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances, the hypothesis is rejected.
